examples.chinese: 我有一個英國朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge Yīngguó péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have a British friend.

examples.chinese: 我的女朋友很喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ péngyǒu hěn xǐhuān hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples.english: My girlfriend likes bubble milk tea very much.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友常常一起去吃冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī bīngqílín.
examples.english: My friends and I often go have ice cream together.

examples.chinese: 我想去朋友家玩，可是沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù péngyǒu jiā wán, kěshì méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: I would like to go to my friend’s place, but I don’t have time.

examples.chinese: 他常常幫朋友，是一個好人。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng bāng péngyǒu, shì yí ge hǎo rén.
examples.english: He helps his friends often. He is a nice guy.

examples.chinese: 今天我去朋友家玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qù péngyǒu jiā wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: I had fun at my friend’s place today.

examples.chinese: 我朋友說這家餐廳的咖啡很好喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu shuō zhè jiā cāntīng de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: My friend said this restaurant’s coffee is good.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友不太喜歡說話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nán péngyǒu bú tài xǐhuān shuōhuà.
examples.english: My boyfriend does not like to talk very much.

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend’s birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 我有幾個臺灣朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge Táiwān péngyǒu.
examples.english: I have a few Taiwanese friends.

examples.chinese: 元真，我們明天幾點去找妳的韓國朋友？
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, wǒmen míngtiān jǐ diǎn qù zhǎo nǐ de Hánguó péngyǒu?
examples.english: Yuanzhen, what time are we going to meet up with your Korean friends tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 朋友常來找我，他們都覺得坐捷運來我家，又快又方便。
examples.pinyin: Péngyǒu cháng lái zhǎo wǒ, tāmen dōu juéde zuò jiéyùn lái wǒ jiā, yòu kuài yòu fāngbiàn.
examples.english: My friends often visit me. They all think taking the MRT to my house is both fast and convenient.

examples.chinese: 我朋友最近比較忙，別的時間他沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zuìjìn bǐjiào máng, biéde shíjiān tā méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: My friend is busier lately; he isn’t available at other times.

examples.chinese: 最近我的台灣朋友想學日文，請我教他，我也請他教我中文。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn wǒ de Táiwān péngyǒu xiǎng xué Rìwén, qǐng wǒ jiāo tā, wǒ yě qǐng tā jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén.
examples.english: These days, one of my Taiwanese friends wants to learn Japanese. He asked me to teach him Japanese, so I asked him to teach me Chinese as well.

examples.chinese: 這是我朋友做的，因為他屬虎。妳知道十二生肖嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou zuò de, yīnwèi tā shǔ hǔ. Nǐ zhīdào shí'èr shēngxiào ma?
examples.english: This is the lantern that my friend made because his Chinese zodiac animal sign is tiger. Do you know the Chinese animal zodiac?

items.wordHook: 朋(companion) + 友(friend) → 朋友 is a friend.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子眼睛不太好，所以每天都戴眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi yǎnjing bù tài hǎo, suǒyǐ měitiān dōu dài yǎnjìng.
examples.english: This child's eyes are not very good, so he wears glasses every day.

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè de yángguāng duì wǒmen de yǎnjing bù hǎo, chūmén huódòng shí zuìhǎo dài shàng tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes; when going out for activities, it's best to wear sunglasses.

examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
他上班時常戴著一副黑色眼鏡，那副樣子總是讓我忘不了。

items.wordHook: 眼(eye) + 鏡(lens) → lenses for the eyes: 眼鏡(glasses).

examples.chinese: 這件事情他自己可以做，不需要我們幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng tā zìjǐ kěyǐ zuò, bù xūyào wǒmen bāngmáng.
examples.english: He can do this matter himself; he doesn't need our help.

examples.chinese: 在外國跟在自己國家的生活一定不太一樣。
examples.pinyin: Zài wàiguó gēn zài zìjǐ guójiā de shēnghuó yídìng bú tài yíyàng.
examples.english: Living in a foreign country and living in your own country are definitely not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 我可以自己回家，你不用陪我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ zìjǐ huí jiā, nǐ bùyòng péi wǒ.
examples.english: I can go home by myself; you don't need to accompany me.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"媽媽不在，晚飯我得自己弄。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"弟弟把房間弄得又髒又亂，誰也不想進去。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Māma bù zài, wǎnfàn wǒ děi zìjǐ nòng. Dìdi bǎ fángjiān nòng de yòu zāng yòu luàn, shéi yě bù xiǎng jìnqù.
examples.english: Mom isn't home, so I have to make dinner myself. My little brother made the room both dirty and messy; no one wants to go in.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"第一次約會的時候，林先生感覺(到)自己很緊張。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這棟公寓除了環境不錯，家具還很新，感覺住起來會很舒服。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì yuēhuì de shíhou, Lín xiānsheng gǎnjué (dào) zìjǐ hěn jǐnzhāng. Zhè dòng gōngyù chúle huánjìng búcuò, jiājù hái hěn xīn, gǎnjué zhù qǐlái huì hěn shūfu.
examples.english: On their first date, Mr. Lin felt that he was very nervous. Besides having a nice environment, this apartment building also has very new furniture; it feels like it would be very comfortable to live in.

examples.chinese: 參加團體旅遊比較不自由，可是不必自己訂旅館、訂車票。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐjiào bù zìyóu, kěshì bùbì zìjǐ dìng lǚguǎn, dìng chēpiào.
examples.english: Joining a group tour is less free, but you don't have to book hotels and tickets yourself.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣覺得方靜文變了，可是靜文覺得自己沒變。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn juéde Fāng Jìngwén biàn le, kěshì Jìngwén juéde zìjǐ méi biàn.
examples.english: Chen Kexin feels that Fang Jingwen has changed, but Jingwen feels that she herself hasn't changed.

examples.chinese: 那個外國學生常跟台灣朋友聊天，用中文表達自己的意見。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó xuéshēng cháng gēn Táiwān péngyǒu liáotiān, yòng Zhōngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: That foreign student often chats with Taiwanese friends, expressing his own opinions in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 那個外國學生常跟台灣朋友聊天，用中文表達自己的意見。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó xuéshēng cháng gēn Táiwān péngyǒu liáotiān, yòng Zhōngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: That foreign student often chats with Taiwanese friends, expressing his own opinions in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 很多父母希望孩子照他們的意思做，因為怕孩子自己做不好。
examples.pinyin: Hěnduō fùmǔ xīwàng háizi zhào tāmen de yìsi zuò, yīnwèi pà háizi zìjǐ zuò bù hǎo.
examples.english: Many parents hope their children will do things according to their wishes, because they are afraid the children won't do well on their own.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩年紀太小，不會自己穿衣服、脫褲子。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái niánjì tài xiǎo, bù huì zìjǐ chuān yīfu, tuō kùzi.
examples.english: That child is too young; he can't put on clothes or take off his pants by himself.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"參加社團活動，是讓自己成長的好機會。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"孩子出國留學以後，父母發現孩子成長了不少。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng, shì ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng de hǎo jīhuì. Háizi chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, fùmǔ fāxiàn háizi chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo.
examples.english: Participating in club activities is a good opportunity for personal growth. After their child went abroad to study, the parents found that the child had grown a lot.

examples.chinese: 很多大學生都打過工，因為得自己付生活費。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng dōu dǎ guò gōng, yīnwèi děi zìjǐ fù shēnghuófèi.
examples.english: Many university students have had part-time jobs because they have to pay their own living expenses.

examples.chinese: 他非常不愛惜自己的東西，所以東西常不見。
examples.pinyin: Tā fēicháng bù àixī zìjǐ de dōngxi, suǒyǐ dōngxi cháng bùjiàn.
examples.english: He doesn't cherish his own things at all, so his things often go missing.

examples.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點兒就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎnr jiù wàng le zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
examples.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—so forgetful!

examples.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎn jiù wàng le zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
examples.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—really silly!

examples.chinese: 我餓的時候，會自己煮飯、煮水餃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ è de shíhou, huì zìjǐ zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo.
examples.english: When I am hungry, I cook rice and boil dumplings myself.

examples.chinese: 我餓的時候，會自己煮飯、煮水餃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ è de shíhou, huì zìjǐ zhǔ fàn, zhǔ shuǐjiǎo.
examples.english: When I am hungry, I cook rice and boil dumplings myself.

examples.chinese: 妹妹知道自己考上了最好的研究所，激動地哭了起來。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei zhīdào zìjǐ kǎo shàng le zuì hǎo de yánjiūsuǒ, jīdòng de kū le qǐlái.
examples.english: When my younger sister learned that she had gotten into the best graduate school, she was so excited that she started crying.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己特殊的風俗習慣，有時候外國人不容易了解。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ tèshū de fēngsú xíguàn, yǒu shíhou wàiguó rén bù róngyì liǎojiě.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own special customs and habits, which sometimes foreigners find hard to understand.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: 何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.
examples.english: Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her.

examples.chinese: 大偉挺喜歡他現在的工作，不但能挑戰自己，也能學習新的東西。
examples.pinyin: Dàwěi tǐng xǐhuān tā xiànzài de gōngzuò, bùdàn néng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, yě néng xuéxí xīn de dōngxi.
examples.english: Dawei quite likes his current job; not only can it challenge him, but he can also learn new things.

examples.chinese: 這道菜能夠這麼好吃，是因為加了特別的醬料，還有自己做的醬油。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài nénggòu zhème hǎochī, shì yīnwèi jiāle tèbié de jiàngliào, hái yǒu zìjǐ zuò de jiàngyóu.
examples.english: This dish can be so delicious because it has special sauce added, plus homemade soy sauce.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的公車司機不找錢，要是你沒有公車卡，就得自己準備零錢。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de gōngchē sījī bù zhǎo qián, yàoshi nǐ méiyǒu gōngchē kǎ, jiù děi zìjǐ zhǔnbèi língqián.
examples.english: Bus drivers in this city don't give change; if you don't have a bus card, you have to prepare exact change yourself.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有自己的優點，不需要強調，也不必跟別人比來比去。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, bù xūyào qiángdiào, yě búbì gēn biérén bǐ lái bǐ qù.
examples.english: Everyone has their own strengths; there is no need to emphasize them, and no need to compare yourself with others back and forth.

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 任何人都應該認真思考自己的未來，別糊里糊塗地過日子。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu yīnggāi rènzhēn sīkǎo zìjǐ de wèilái, bié húlǐhútú de guò rìzi.
examples.english: Everyone should seriously think about their own future, and not live their days muddleheadedly.

examples.chinese: 地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng. Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english: During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury. When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english: No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 這個平板的使用說明寫得很詳細，客人自己看就能明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège píngbǎn de shǐyòng shuōmíng xiě de hěn xiángxì, kèrén zìjǐ kàn jiù néng míngbai le.
examples.english: The user manual for this tablet is written in great detail; customers can understand it just by reading it themselves.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: 我覺得馬小姐找不到工作的原因不是自己的條件不夠好，是他太缺乏自信了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Mǎ xiǎojiě zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò de yuányīn bùshì zìjǐ de tiáojiàn bù gòu hǎo, shì tā tài quēfá zìxìn le.
examples.english: I think the reason Miss Ma can't find a job is not that her own qualifications aren't good enough, but that she lacks self-confidence too much.

examples.chinese: 陳先生有五個孩子，生活費負擔很大。小張不想增加父親的負擔，為了負擔自己的學費，一下課就去打工。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng yǒu wǔ gè háizi, shēnghuófèi fùdān hěn dà. Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng zēngjiā fùqīn de fùdān, wèile fùdān zìjǐ de xuéfèi, yī xiàkè jiù qù dǎgōng.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has five children, so the burden of living expenses is very great. Little Zhang doesn't want to increase his father's burden; in order to shoulder his own tuition, he goes to work as soon as class is over.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 電影明星一向很重視自己的穿著，合適的穿著才能讓他們更有品味、更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng míngxīng yīxiàng hěn zhòngshì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó, héshì de chuānzhuó cái néng ràng tāmen gèng yǒu pǐnwèi, gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Movie stars have always attached great importance to their clothing; only suitable clothing can make them have more taste and more confidence.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 父母不能保護孩子一輩子，得讓他們自己經驗一些挫折，才能培養出堅強的性格。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng bǎohù háizi yībèizi, děi ràng tāmen zìjǐ jīngyàn yīxiē cuòzhé, cái néng péiyǎng chū jiānqiáng de xìnggé.
examples.english: Parents cannot protect their children for a lifetime; they must let them experience some frustrations themselves in order to cultivate a strong character.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 從小父母就教導我要做個好人，別讓人看不起自己。
examples.pinyin: Cóngxiǎo fùmǔ jiù jiàodǎo wǒ yào zuò ge hǎorén, bié ràng rén kànbuqǐ zìjǐ.
examples.english: Since I was little, my parents taught me to be a good person and not let others look down on me.

examples.chinese: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.
examples.english: Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 人人都希望自己的孩子有幸福的生活、美好的未來。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi yǒu xìngfú de shēnghuó, měihǎo de wèilái.
examples.english: Everyone hopes their children will have a happy life and a beautiful future.

examples.chinese: 你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ máng bú guòlái de shíhou jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāngmáng, bié ràng zìjǐ lèihuài le.
examples.english: When you are too busy to manage, you should find someone to help; don't let yourself get exhausted.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: 《生日快樂》是全世界著名的歌曲，不同國家的人也能用自己的語言唱出來。
examples.pinyin: 《Shēngrì Kuàilè》 shì quán shìjiè zhùmíng de gēqǔ, bùtóng guójiā de rén yě néng yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán chàng chūlái.
examples.english: "Happy Birthday" is a world-famous song; people from different countries can also sing it in their own languages.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yǔyán hé wénzì, yě yòng tāmen lái jìlù lìshǐ.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own language and writing, and also uses them to record history.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 誰都無法告訴你生命的意義是什麼，只能自己去尋找答案。
examples.pinyin: Shéi dōu wúfǎ gàosù nǐ shēngmìng de yìyì shì shénme, zhǐ néng zìjǐ qù xúnzhǎo dá'àn.
examples.english: No one is able to tell you what the meaning of life is; you can only search for the answer yourself.

examples.chinese: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
examples.pinyin: Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.
examples.english: Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee.

examples.chinese: 自己開店做老闆，事事都得自己來，其實不太容易。
在臺灣，收到禮物的人要找機會回禮，表達自己的感謝。
想讓別人看得起你，你得先看得起自己。
一個人做錯事多半是自己造成的，不能一做錯就怪別人。
他對自己很小氣，可是對朋友卻很大方。
人人都有屬於自己的長處，要對自己更有信心。
想吃得安心、吃得健康，自己親手做是必需的。
我想加入社會服務組織，幫助別人的同時也讓自己成長。
我想出國當背包客，除了能打開視野，並能訓練自己更獨立。
他利用發傳單的方式來宣傳自己新開的餐廳。
他願意挑戰自己的工作能力，並積極地克服挫折，真是難得。
每個時代都有自己的價值標準，社會習俗及生活規矩也常隨著時代改變。
人類破壞了自然，就是破壞了自己的生活環境。
完全按照別人的話來工作，是很省事沒錯，卻失去了讓自己進步的機會。
他靠自己的力量，經過了十年，終於完成了這個發明。
練習八百公尺跑步時，教練除了要大家記得自己是跑第幾棒的，並且提醒我們把棒子拿好。
對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
所有令人傷腦筋的過程，都是為了使自己變成腦筋很好的人。
那位母親寧可犧牲自己的生命，也要保護孩子的安全。
所謂「人助天助」的意思，就是得自己先努力，天(God,Heavens)才會幫助你。
你的身體狀況不太好，就別自己開車了，讓我送你回家。
參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
自從住校以後，我得學習自己收拾、整理房間。
有些運動中心規定個人得帶自己的毛巾，否則不可以進去。
缺少運動的人總是說自己太忙，缺時間去活動。
知道自己誤會別人以後，最好早一點兒跟對方道歉。
生活忙碌的時候，也要給自己留一些休息時間。
自己做的肥皂用起來比較安心，也能選擇自己喜歡的氣味。
A:你說自己沒有想做的事，難道你沒有夢想嗎？ B:我只想簡單過生活，再說，沒有夢想難道不行嗎？
我們無法控制別人的行為，卻能夠改變自己的想法。
你不需要事事都跟別人做比較，自己過得輕鬆愉快就好。
有時一個人的前途無法先規劃好，必須自己創造。
到外面做了丟人的事，自己和家人也會覺得丟臉。
如果說能回到過去，我最想放下工作，追求自己的興趣。
學習外國語言時最好能找位專業的老師，好改正自己的錯誤。
A:幸虧有你的建議，投資計畫才有很好的結果，真是多謝你了？ B:哪裡哪裡，都是你自己努力得到的成果，要謝就謝你自己吧！
當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
王媽媽一直把媳婦當作自己的女兒，當他們家的媳婦真幸福。
經過血液檢查，人們就可以知道自己的血型。
她想嫁給有錢人家(rénjiā)是她自己的事，你幹嘛管人家(rénjia)的事？
天天說自己外行、不願嘗試的人，就無法更深入地瞭解世界。
各行各業都有屬於自己的專業，無法比較誰高誰低。
我習慣把每一筆支出都記錄起來，提醒自己少花點兒錢。
開車時不闖紅燈，是為了自己和別人的生命安全。
當你願意開放自己的心時， 你所見的世界也會更加地美妙。
今天王醫師門診，沒有護理師協助，什麼事都得自己動手。
隨著科技進步，醫學也不斷前進，當醫師的人得多充實自己。
你在外面花錢吃不健康的食物，還不如自己在家煮。
有人喜歡在枕頭上抹一點兒自己喜歡的香水，聽說可以紓壓。
大學畢業後，同學們就奔向自己的人生目標，五年後才聚在一起。
他勸我別太在意別人的眼光，把自己負責的事完成就好。
雖然受到了重大的挫折，可是他並沒有放棄自己的夢想。
父母總是捨得給孩子最好的，卻捨不得對自己好一點兒。
這件事大家都堅持自己的觀點，討論不出結果，還是找個說話有分量的人來決定吧。
每個宗教都有屬於自己的獨特儀式。
看到自己國家的國旗進入奧運會場，民眾也不斷揮著手上的小旗子，替自己的國家加油。
重道德的人，即使在沒人看見的地方也會注意自己的行為。

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān bàngōngshì de lěngqì bù lěng, kěnéng lěngqìjī yǒu wèntí.
examples.english: Today the air conditioning in the office is not cold; there might be a problem with the air conditioner.

examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xiàtiān hěn rè, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén de jiālǐ dōu zhuāng le lěngqì. Zhège dàizi hěn dà, kěyǐ zhuāng hěn duō dōngxī.
examples.english: Summers in Taiwan are very hot, so many people's homes have installed air conditioning. This bag is very big; it can pack a lot of things.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le. Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english: My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m. Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese: 我每個月都會清一次冷氣，這樣比較省電，風也比較涼。
開冷氣時如果能好好利用電扇，房間很快就涼了。
冷氣的溫度要是控制得剛好，不但對健康好，也能省點兒電費。
在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
有哪些動物？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu nǎxiē dòngwù?
examples.english: What animals are there in the book?

examples.chinese: 華人用不一樣的動物代表每一年，一共有十二種動物。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng bù yíyàng de dòngwù dàibiǎo měi yì nián, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù.
examples.english: Chinese use different animals to represent each year, and there are a total of twelve kinds of animals.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

items.wordHook: 動(move) + 物(thing) → a moving thing: 動物 means animal.

examples.chinese: 台灣從北到南有三百八十五公里。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān cóng běi dào nán yǒu sānbǎi bāshíwǔ gōnglǐ.
examples.english: Taiwan is 385 kilometers from north to south.

examples.chinese: 這條鐵路從北部一直到南部，一共三百公里。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo tiělù cóng běibù yīzhí dào nánbù, yīgòng sānbǎi gōnglǐ.
examples.english: This railway goes from the north all the way to the south, a total of 300 kilometers.

examples.chinese: 臺灣是一個南北長約三百八十公里的海島，約有兩千三百五十萬人。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shì yīgè nánběi cháng yuē sānbǎi bāshí gōnglǐ de hǎidǎo, yuē yǒu liǎngqiān sānbǎi wǔshí wàn rén.
examples.english: Taiwan is an island about 380 kilometers long from north to south, with approximately 23.5 million people.

examples.chinese: 這條道路限制車速五十公里，你不能再加速了。

items.wordHook: 公(metric) + 里(a half-kilometer) → the metric version of the 里: 公里(kilometer).

examples.chinese: 這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu hái méi cā gān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
examples.english: I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

examples.chinese: 昨天洗的衣服乾了沒有？這些碗筷、刀叉我都還沒擦乾，不可以給客人用。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān xǐ de yīfu gān le méiyǒu? Zhèxiē wǎnkuài, dāochā wǒ dōu hái méi cā gān, bù kěyǐ gěi kèrén yòng.
examples.english: Are the clothes washed yesterday dry yet? I haven't dried these bowls, chopsticks, and cutlery yet; they can't be given to guests to use.

examples.chinese: 龍山寺是台北很有名的寺廟，廟裡常常有很多外國遊客。
examples.pinyin: Lóngshānsì shì Táiběi hěn yǒumíng de sìmiào, miào lǐ chángcháng yǒu hěn duō wàiguó yóukè.
examples.english: Longshan Temple is a very famous temple in Taipei; there are often many foreign tourists in the temple.

examples.chinese: 去那座寺廟拜拜的人真多，他們在拜什麼？
examples.pinyin: Qù nà zuò sìmiào bài bài de rén zhēn duō, tāmen zài bài shénme?
examples.english: There are really many people going to that temple to worship—what are they worshipping?

examples.chinese: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
examples.pinyin: Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.
examples.english: Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple.

examples.chinese: 這次考試的分數沒有我想的那麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de fēnshù méiyǒu wǒ xiǎng de nàme chà.
examples.english: The score on this exam is not as bad as I thought.

examples.chinese: 這次考試很難，可是大家的分數都不低，好奇怪！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì hěn nán, kěshì dàjiā de fēnshù dōu bù dī, hǎo qíguài!
examples.english: This exam was very hard, but everyone's scores are not low—how strange!

examples.chinese: 這篇作文的錯字太多了，所以分數不高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān zuòwén de cuòzì tài duō le, suǒyǐ fēnshù bù gāo.
examples.english: This essay has too many wrong characters, so the score is not high.

examples.chinese: 老師認為這個問題很難，只有一個學生回答得很正確，所以給他加了一些分數。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènwéi zhège wèntí hěn nán, zhǐyǒu yí ge xuésheng huídá de hěn zhèngquè, suǒyǐ gěi tā jiā le yìxiē fēnshù.
examples.english: The teacher thought this question was very difficult, and only one student answered very correctly, so he gave him some extra points.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 參加廚師比賽，只要味道部分的分數很高，就有機會得獎。

examples.pinyin: Jiànshēn jiàoliàn xùnliàn wǒ mànpǎo, xīwàng wǒ yuè pǎo yuè jiànkāng.
examples.english: The fitness coach trains me to jog, hoping that the more I run, the healthier I will become.

examples.english: The fitness coach trains me to jog, hoping that the more I run, the healthier I will become.

examples.pinyin: Jiànshēn jiàoliàn shuō, děng wǒ bìng hǎo le, tǐlì hǎo yīdiǎnr le, jiù yīnggāi jìxù mànpǎo. Jīntiān shàngkè shàng dào zhèlǐ, míngtiān zài jìxù ba!
examples.english: The fitness coach said that once I recover from my illness and my stamina is a bit better, I should continue jogging. Today's class will stop here; let's continue tomorrow!

examples.chinese: 像慢跑、游泳那樣的運動，對健康極有幫助。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng mànpǎo, yóuyǒng nàyàng de yùndòng, duì jiànkāng jí yǒu bāngzhù.
examples.english: Sports like jogging and swimming are extremely helpful for health.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 我花了大約兩萬塊錢學做法國菜，希望能夠快點兒學會。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huā le dàyuē liǎngwàn kuài qián xué zuò Fǎguó cài, xīwàng nénggòu kuài diǎnr xuéhuì.
examples.english: I spent about 20,000 dollars learning to cook French cuisine, hoping to be able to learn it quickly.

examples.chinese: 臺灣一般舊公寓的房子大約三十多坪，有客廳、廚房、一間浴室和三間臥房。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yìbān jiù gōngyù de fángzi dàyuē sānshí duō píng, yǒu kètīng, chúfáng, yì jiān yùshì hé sān jiān wòfáng.
examples.english: A typical old apartment in Taiwan is about thirty-something ping, with a living room, a kitchen, one bathroom, and three bedrooms.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 地球的表面大約百分之七十是水，百分之三十是地。
examples.pinyin: Dìqiú de biǎomiàn dàyuē bǎifēnzhī qīshí shì shuǐ, bǎifēnzhī sānshí shì dì.
examples.english: About seventy percent of the Earth's surface is water, and thirty percent is land.

examples.chinese: 搭飛機時，行李的重量是有限制的，大約一件25公斤。
這輛卡車有十二個輪子，大約能載二十五噸的物品。
在臺灣，目前已被發現的蝴蝶大約有三百七十種以上。
我家的客廳當中擺了一套皮沙發。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de kètīng dāngzhōng bǎi le yí tào pí shāfā.
examples.english: In the middle of my living room, a leather sofa set is placed.

examples.chinese: 五年前經驗過護照被偷的意外後，每次出國我都把護照放在上衣裡面的口袋。
examples.pinyin: Wǔ nián qián jīngyàn guò hùzhào bèi tōu de yìwài hòu, měi cì chūguó wǒ dōu bǎ hùzhào fàng zài shàngyī lǐmiàn de kǒudài.
examples.english: After experiencing the accident of having my passport stolen five years ago, every time I go abroad, I put my passport in the pocket inside my jacket.

examples.chinese: 你別把剛領的鈔票放在口袋裡，很容易不見的。

items.wordHook: Combining 口(mouth) and 袋(bag): 口袋 means pockets.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 有人覺得留鬍子比較帥，我倒是覺得留了鬍子看起來比較老。
章小姐接觸電影表演工作不久，雖然還是新人，對表演技巧倒是掌握得挺好的。
中國的古書雖然難懂，慢慢讀的話，我倒是多少能理解一些。
我不太會跳高，跳遠倒是跳得還不錯。

items.wordHook: Combining 倒(fall down) and 是(be): 倒是 means sure it is, but.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 新學期快要開始了。我們每天八點四十分開始上課。
examples.pinyin: Xīn xuéqī kuài yào kāishǐ le. Wǒmen měi tiān bā diǎn sìshí fēn kāishǐ shàngkè.
examples.english: The new semester is about to start. We start class at 8:40 every day.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯透過網路、報紙，尋找三十年前因為戰爭而分開的家人，最後終於找到了。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo tòuguò wǎnglù, bàozhǐ, xúnzhǎo sānshí nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér fēnkāi de jiārén, zuìhòu zhōngyú zhǎodào le.
examples.english: Uncle Lin searched through the Internet and newspapers for family members separated thirty years ago because of war, and finally found them.

examples.chinese: 這套書分上下兩冊，買書時不可分開購買。
A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 《生日快樂》是全世界著名的歌曲，不同國家的人也能用自己的語言唱出來。
examples.pinyin: 《Shēngrì Kuàilè》 shì quán shìjiè zhùmíng de gēqǔ, bùtóng guójiā de rén yě néng yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán chàng chūlái.
examples.english: "Happy Birthday" is a world-famous song; people from different countries can also sing it in their own languages.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
台灣有句著名的廣告台詞「心動不如馬上行動」，意思是當個人有了想法之後，光是想是沒用的，得立刻行動才行。
離我家不遠的劇院，是請著名設計師來設計的。

A:那所大學雖然相當著名，但我國政府不承認他們的學位(academic degree)。B:許多國家都承認那所大學的學位，貴國哪裡有不承認的道理？
包著紅豆餡，裹著花生粉的麻糬，是臺灣著名的傳統甜點。
這位著名畫家的作品，目前正在美術館展出。
訓練出著名跳高選手的教練認為，要跳得高，技巧很重要。
這家工廠奪下了著名品牌產品的製造機會。

items.wordHook: Combining 著(show) and 名(measure word for people): 著名 means famous.

items.wordHook: Assessing overall 健(strong) vitality and 康(health) by conducting a 檢(check) and 查(investigate): 健康檢查 means physical check-up.
別(other) + 人(person) → other people: 別人(others).
A lush 木(tree) by the 羕(river) takes on its true 樣(form).
The 斤(axe) chops away the 欠(lack), so nothing is missing → 欣(delighted).
A puff of 气(air) takes the scent of cooking 米(rice) → fresh 氣(air).
Combining 觀(observe) and 念(think of): 觀念 means concept.
Along the winding 辶(movement) trail, one supply 車(cart) links to the next to 連(join).
